title: GREEN is FORWARD. BROWN is DOWN to the belly. BLUE is OUT to the sides.

do_not_reinvent.body: /data/chromatic-directionality.json — already a color body. do not reprint Mendeleev of hues.
do_not_reinvent.hole: /data/green-removed-null-axis.json — green is not a lime badge. the hole is the axis. FORWARD is the vector through that hole.
do_not_reinvent.zx: /data/ingest-exhaust-zx.json — brown stays fertile dirt. fleet. now it is also the belly.
do_not_reinvent.vdj: /data/chromatic-vdj.json — red still σ. do not drop it. this file names three directions they asked.

green_forward.not: a painted stance. not 'green stays' as costume.
green_forward.is: the walk. through the missing-green hole. the null axis POINTS this way.

brown_belly.yes: brown is DOWN to the belly.
brown_belly.was: under the feet. earth. still true.
brown_belly.now: the gut. Fe. iron peak. where heat sits. gravity into the body, not only the floor.

blue_sides.yes: blue is OUT to the sides.
blue_sides.is: span. laterals. cool field. both arms.
blue_sides.not: only one flank. red can stay the HIT / aft. blue is how wide.

pull: face forward through the green hole. brown into the belly. blue out the sides. look up still purple. no lime.
